rule_text.name: 702.196a
rule_text.rule: Engorge is a static ability. “Engorge” means “As this creature enters, put the top three cards of your library into your graveyard, then exile exactly one card put into your graveyard this way.”

rule_text.name: 702.196b
rule_text.rule: A creature with engorge may refer to the card exiled this way as “the card it engorged.”

representative_cards.name: Abhorrent Exhumer
representative_cards.original_text:

Type: Creature — Zombie
Power/Toughness: 3/2
Engorge *(As this enters, mill three cards, then exile a card from among the milled cards.)*
When Abhorrent Exhumer enters, if it engorged a creature card, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
